frozen_spec.complete_rule: a record is guard-runnable iff it carries all four inputs
frozen_spec.domain_rule: every BAND*.json in results/state_tilt except the _latest.json byte mirrors: the mirrors are the same face twice
frozen_spec.join_rule: a collection is joined against the canonical row collection of the face that published the rows; a shared number must match to 1e-09, so presence alone cannot pass
frozen_spec.presence_rule: a field is present iff the key exists and its value is not None; 0.0 is a value -- a zero is a measurement, not a missing number
frozen_spec.verdict_rule: disagreement outranks incompleteness: two faces publishing different values for one row is a stronger finding than a face that publishes no value at all

inventory_note: the counts below are those of THIS inventory: the domain grows whenever the machine publishes another dated BAND* face, so verify re-derives over the published list rather than over whatever is on disk at verification time
no_bill: measurement only: the published band faces are re-read and field-checked; no shuffle stream is drawn, no band is rebuilt, no engine runs. A field that is present here is present on disk -- nothing is re-derived from the market.

summary.resolve_note: join keys are (index) when unique in the canonical face, else (index, leg, base, cell); records without an index are counted as unjoined, never dropped

title: does every published face a screen reads actually carry the guard's inputs?
verdict_reason: 27 verdict-bearing collection(s) (584 records) publish a judgement without the four inputs, while the guard's own triple lives on 4 collection(s) (72 record(s), 3 of them on measured rows only): the screen is a table recipe on the faces that carry it and a black box on the rest
